notes: School of Music official Music - Bachelor of Arts - Strings Four Year Academic Plan. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out (only the major is audited).

MUSC229 (ensemble, 1 credit) and MUSC099 (recital attendance, 1 credit) are repeatable and entered multiple times per the plan's own '(1 cr. x N semesters)' legend lines; see the program's reviewNotes.
The '6 credits of music electives' generic 3xx-4xx slot is filled with MUSC434 and MUSC461, both from the Academic Catalog's approved MUSC course list (the source names no specific elective course).
